register_box_type: register a new box type class as a decorator or function call with a unique name
register_box_converter: register a converter function to transform boxes from one type to another using decorator or function
get_box_type: get the box type name and class by passing a string name or BaseBoxes subclass
convert_box_type: convert boxes from a source type to a destination type using a registered converter
autocast_box_type: decorate a transform function to automatically cast gt_bboxes to the destination box type
